fusions.name: Linked Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Shared Shackle
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tethered to Me
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Together
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 2 health and your maximum health rises by 10. Each of these rises 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
